notes.title: Truecolors - Early Access v1.8.3.0 Release
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Today, Truecolors is updated to version 1.8.3.0.

This version includes bug fixes and some enhancements. See below for more information.



1. The maximum value of the stamina has been increased.

2. The error of recreating some objects and items has been corrected.

3. Some quest progress errors have been corrected.

4. Some quest contents have been changed.

5. Some of the clue items have changed shape and position.

6. Some tutorial contents have been modified.

7. Some UI have been modified.



Our development team is aware of the translation issue in English and hopes to resolve it as soon as possible.

Thank you.
